title: On exploring effects of coevolving residues on DNA binding specificity of transcription factors
one_liner_zh: 该文通过高通量实验数据系统分析七个TF家族中共进化残基对DNA结合特异性的影响，虽涉及TF-DNA互作机制，但主要依赖序列统计和实验验证，缺乏AI或物理模拟建模方法。
abstract: Transcription factors (TFs) regulate gene expression by specifically binding to DNA targets. Many factors have been revealed to influence TF-DNA binding specificity. Coevolution of residues in proteins occurs due to a common evolutionary history. However, it is unclear how coevolving residues in TFs contribute to DNA binding specificity. Here, we systematically analyzed TF-DNA interactions from high-throughput experiments for seven TF families, including Homeobox, HLH, bZIP_1, Ets, HMG_box, zf-C4 and Zn_clus TFs. Based on TF-DNA interactions, we detected TF subclass determining sites (TSDSs) defining the heterogeneity of DNA binding preference for each TF family. We showed that the TSDSs were more likely to be coevolving with TSDSs than with non-TSDSs, particularly for Homeobox, HLH, Ets, bZIP_1 and HMG_box TF families. Mutation of the highly coevolving residues could significantly reduce the stability of TF-DNA complex. The distant residues from the DNA interface also contributed to TF-DNA binding activity. Overall, our study gave evidence of the functional importance of coevolved residues in refining transcriptional regulation and provided clues to the application of engineered DNA-binding domains and protein.
abstract_zh: 转录因子（TFs）通过特异性结合DNA靶点来调控基因表达。已有多项因素被揭示影响TF-DNA结合特异性。蛋白质中残基的共进化源于共同的进化历史。然而，TF中共进化残基如何促进DNA结合特异性尚不清楚。在此，我们系统分析了来自高通量实验中七个TF家族（包括Homeobox、HLH、bZIP_1、Ets、HMG_box、zf-C4和Zn_clus TFs）的TF-DNA相互作用。基于TF-DNA相互作用，我们检测了决定每个TF家族DNA结合偏好异质性的TF亚类决定位点（TSDSs）。我们表明，TSDSs更倾向于与其他TSDSs共进化，而非与非TSDSs共进化，尤其是在Homeobox、HLH、Ets、bZIP_1和HMG_box TF家族中。高度共进化残基的突变能显著降低TF-DNA复合物的稳定性。远离DNA界面的残基也对TF-DNA结合活性有贡献。总体而言，我们的研究为共进化残基在精细调控转录中的功能重要性提供了证据，并为工程化DNA结合域和蛋白质的应用提供了线索。
